page_title: EMP 0-0 FRO | Empoli v Frosinone 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Frosinone couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Elia Caprile (Empoli) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
90+3' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Matias Soule is given a rest as he is replaced by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone).
90+1' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Surely that's handball by one of the Empoli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:5.
88' Total attempts – 7:15.
87' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) is adjudged offside.

87' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile was ready and made a save.
85' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Marco Brescianini will be replaced by Francesco Gelli (Frosinone).
84' It's time for a substitution. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) comes on in place of Giuseppe Pezzella.

83' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) latched on to an accurate cross inside the box and attempted to direct the ball with a nice header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep the ball out.
83' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
81' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli).
79' Matias Soule (Frosinone) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
78' The percentage of ball possession is – 47:53.
76' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) for his blatant foul.
75' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
74' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Walid Cheddira walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
73' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Bonifazi (Frosinone) is brought on as a substitute for Simone Romagnoli.
71' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
71' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Nicolo Cambiaghi and he is replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).
71' Substitution. Jacopo Fazzini did his best and is replaced by Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli).
69' The corner is swung in but Frosinone can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Matias Soule (Frosinone) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from Frosinone as they win a corner.
68' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Doveri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

64' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Surely that's handball by one of the Empoli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
60' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
60' The resulting corner from Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) comes to nothing.
59' Matias Soule (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Frosinone earn a corner.
59' The game is interrupted. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
57' Daniele Doveri blows for a foul after Francesco Caputo (Empoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
55' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francesco Caputo (Empoli) replacing M'Baye Niang.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Grassi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Youssef Maleh (Empoli).
53' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Frosinone will take a corner.
50' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
50' There's an opportunity for Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
50' A cross into the box from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Frosinone take a short corner kick.

49' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Frosinone.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.

47' Razvan Marin (Empoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Frosinone have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.

43' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Frosinone.
40' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Elia Caprile easily deals with the threat.
38' The resulting set piece from Empoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Empoli.
37' The ball is cleared after Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It's a throw-in for Empoli.
36' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
34' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
32' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
32' It will be a corner kick for Empoli. Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
31' Neat passing move from Empoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Corner kicks – 0:2.
26' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
25' Frosinone play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
23' The ball possession is 44:56.
21' The goal by Empoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
21' The Empoli players halt their celebrations as referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
20' Goal! Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
19' Empoli will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
16' Flag up against M'Baye Niang (Empoli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
15' Frosinone are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Elia Caprile steps in and intercepts a long pass from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone).
13' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
11' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
10' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

8' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Frosinone will take a throw-in.
6' A cross from a corner kick by Frosinone is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

5' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Elia Caprile thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The referee blows his whistle, Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
3' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
2' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Frosinone will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will supervise the game today.
